quotes.author: Qur'an 5:8

quotes.text: They plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners.
quotes.author: Qur'an 3:54

quotes.text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested you.
quotes.author: Qur'an 93:3

quotes.text: There are two blessings many people lose: health and free time.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: And whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will be enough for him.
quotes.author: Qur'an 65:3

quotes.text: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction.
quotes.author: Qur'an 16:125

quotes.text: Whoever saves one life, it is as if he had saved mankind entirely.
quotes.author: Qur'an 5:32

quotes.text: The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: Indeed, what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.
quotes.author: Qur'an 93:4

quotes.text: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
quotes.author: Qur'an 94:5-6

quotes.text: For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts.
quotes.author: Qur'an 22:46

quotes.text: Say, “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.”
quotes.author: Qur'an 39:53

quotes.text: Stand firm for justice, as witnesses to Allah, even if it be against yourselves.
quotes.author: Qur'an 4:135

quotes.text: Did you think that We created you without purpose, and that you would not be returned to Us?
quotes.author: Qur'an 23:115

quotes.text: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
quotes.author: Qur'an 13:11

quotes.text: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: If Allah knows any good in your hearts, He will give you something better than what was taken from you.
quotes.author: Qur'an 8:70

quotes.text: When you see someone who has been given more than you in wealth and beauty, look to those who have been given less.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: O son of Adam, even if your sins reached the clouds of the sky and you then asked My forgiveness, I would forgive you.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad (Hadith Qudsi)

quotes.text: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.
quotes.author: Qur'an 2:186

quotes.text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another.
quotes.author: Qur'an 49:13

quotes.text: It may be that you dislike a thing which is good for you, and that you like a thing which is bad for you. Allah knows, while you know not.
quotes.author: Qur'an 2:216

quotes.text: And ease for me my task.
quotes.author: Qur'an 20:26

quotes.text: And We created you in pairs.
quotes.author: Qur'an 78:8

quotes.text: And when you speak, be just.
quotes.author: Qur'an 6:152

quotes.text: And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
quotes.author: Qur'an 25:20

quotes.text: My success is only through Allah.
quotes.author: Qur'an 11:88

quotes.text: Does he not know that Allah sees?
quotes.author: Qur'an 96:14

quotes.text: He does not repay evil with evil, but pardons and forgives.
quotes.author: Description of the Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: From the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving what does not concern him.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad

quotes.text: A space in Paradise the size of a whip is better than the world and what is in it.
quotes.author: Prophet Muhammad
